text: She pulled the trigger on her own son.
Both barrels. Silver.
Nothing happened.
I'm a werewolf. So's her son, Danny. My best mate.
Since his uncle Mick died, she's kept the watch on our street.
Danny ran for the moor. She didn't go after him.
She broke the gun open.
Both barrels were empty.
She'd never loaded it. Not once.
Then she gave me a page from Mick's notebook.
August, two thousand and six. His left hand, shaking.
D. bit the boy. Got him off. Cost me the arm.
I was the boy. I was eight.
Mick didn't lose his arm to a wolf.
He lost it pulling one off me.
By dawn, my hands were mine again.
But Danny never came home.
From my window, I saw him at the edge of the moor.
Two eyes. And beside them, a smaller pair.
Come out.
